address: Atlantis The Royal, Crescent Road, The Palm Jumeriah, Dubai
bio: From celebrity chef Ariana Bundy comes this fragrant, pastel-coloured restaurant on the ground floor of Atlantis The Royal, with its almost tent-like feel and a fine covered terrace with views of the gardens. The appealing menu offers a host of Persian foods and flavours, from vibrant salads to charred meats and kababs, all designed for sharing, along with a great selection of teas. You’ll leave feeling good about life....
